narrative.details: Good to see you again adventurer. It does appear that we need more light leather for the creation of the various war materiel. If you could bring me a stack of ten that would be just perfect.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 light leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for your generous donation, adventurer. I'm going to get those onto the pile right now, and in no time I'm sure that they'll get changed into a nice set of armor, some leather patches, or used for something else in our preparations. Seems like we're always in need of more light leather. Come back and visit me soon.
narrative.requestItemsText: Good to see you again, adventurer. It does appear that we need more light leather for the creation of the various war materiels. If you would bring me a stack of ten, that would be just perfect.
